sub: Week 12, Sat 11/21 supper to Wed 11/25 supper.

days.note: Only supper is in the plan today. Quick crockpot chicken that cooks in about 2 hours.
am: When the groceries arrive, put the cold items away first.
By 3:00 pm: cut the thighs into 1 inch pieces, mix the sauce and start the crockpot on high (about 2 to 2 1/2 hours).
pm: About 4:45 pm: start the rice and microwave the broccoli. Thicken the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
After dinner: refrigerate leftover chicken within 2 hours and wash the crockpot.
Tonight at 10 pm: start the cheesy grits in the clean crockpot on low.
meals: Crockpot soy-maple chicken with rice and broccoli

days.note: Grits cooked overnight, lunch is hot dogs, and the macaroni cooks itself this afternoon.
am: Stir the butter and cheddar into the grits and top with banana slices. Wash the crockpot.
By 11:30 am: start the cheeseburger macaroni base in the crockpot (turkey, onion, sauce and broth on low).
Lunch: heat the hot dogs, serve with carrots and mandarins.
pm: About 4:15 pm: stir the macaroni into the crockpot on high (30 to 45 minutes), then the evaporated milk and cheddar. Microwave the broccoli.
After dinner: refrigerate the leftover macaroni for Monday lunch. Wash the crockpot.
Tonight: assemble the French toast casserole in a 9x13 dish, cover and refrigerate.
meals: Hot dogs with carrot sticks and a mandarin

days.note: French toast bakes while everyone wakes up. The whole chicken goes in mid-morning and cooks all day.
am: As soon as you are up: heat the oven to 350 and bake the French toast casserole (40 to 45 minutes). Top with Greek yogurt and apple slices.
By 9:30 am: put the whole fresh chicken on the vegetables in the crockpot (low 7 to 8 hours). Never use a frozen chicken.
Lunch: leftover macaroni, or a turkey and cheese sandwich with carrots and fruit.
pm: After dinner: pull all the leftover chicken off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 3 cups for Wednesday).
Tonight: assemble the egg and toast bake in a 9x13 dish, cover and refrigerate.
meals: Assembled the night before, baked in the morning
Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
Crockpot whole chicken with potatoes and carrots

days.note: Egg bake bakes while everyone wakes up, lunch is pizza bites, sloppy joes cook in the afternoon.
am: As soon as you are up: heat the oven to 350 and bake the egg and toast bake (35 to 40 minutes).
By 12:00 pm: start the sloppy joes in the crockpot (low 5 to 6 hours).
Lunch: bake the pizza bites as directed and serve with carrots and fruit.
pm: After dinner: refrigerate the leftover sloppy joes for Wednesday lunch. Wash the crockpot.
Tonight at 10 pm: start the chocolate peanut butter oatmeal on low.
meals: Overnight cheesy egg and toast bake
Assembled the night before, baked in the morning
Pizza bites with carrot sticks and fruit
White cheddar popcorn and cheese cubes
Crockpot turkey sloppy joes with carrot sticks

days.note: Easy day. Leftovers for lunch and a quick crockpot supper from Monday's chicken.
am: Stir the peanut butter and maple into the chocolate peanut butter oatmeal. Top with banana and chips. Wash the crockpot.
Lunch: leftover sloppy joes, or turkey sandwiches for anyone who wants one.
Take the Monday leftover chicken out of the fridge to warm up a bit before supper.
pm: By 3:30 pm: put the leftover chicken, BBQ sauce and water in the crockpot on low (1 1/2 to 2 hours).
After supper, this plan ends. Next plan starts Thursday.
meals: Crockpot BBQ chicken sandwiches with carrot sticks

b_eggbake.t: Overnight cheesy egg and toast bake (baked in the morning)
ing: 5 slices sandwich bread, cut into cubes
1 1/2 cups cheddar, cubed or grated from a block
1 tbsp olive oil for greasing the dish
st: The night before: rub a 9x13 baking dish with the olive oil and layer in the bread cubes and cheddar.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over. Press the bread down, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Morning: heat the oven to 350. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes, until set in the middle.
Scoop into bowls with a mandarin or sliced banana on the side.
Pack or plate as listed.

s_carrot_pretzel.t: Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
ing: 2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt stirred with a pinch of ranch seasoning
6 pretzel twists or a small handful
st: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt. Pack or plate as listed.
Pack or plate as listed.
Slice the banana and serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

d_chicken.t: Crockpot whole chicken with potatoes and carrots
ing: 1 whole fresh chicken, 4 to 5 lb (not frozen)
st: Put the onion, potatoes and carrots in the bottom of the crockpot and pour in the broth.
Rub the chicken with the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and set it on top, breast side up.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours, until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165.
Serve with the vegetables. After dinner pull all the leftover meat off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 3 cups for Sunday lunch and Monday).

ing: 1 1/2 cups stone-ground or regular grits (not instant)
1 cup cheddar, grated from a block
st: Grease the crockpot lightly. Add the grits, water, milk and salt.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours overnight. If you forget, cook on high 2 to 3 hours in the morning and stir halfway.
Stir in the butter and cheddar until melted. Top with banana slices.
Spoon the yogurt into a cup and top with granola and a little maple.
Slice the apple and serve with the peanut butter.

d_joes.t: Crockpot turkey sloppy joes with carrot sticks
ing: Carrot sticks, about 6 baby carrots per person
st: Crumble the raw turkey into the crockpot with the onion.
Stir the tomato sauce, tomato paste, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire, brown sugar, garlic powder and salt together and pour over.
Cook on low 5 to 6 hours or high 3. Break up the turkey with a spoon halfway and again at the end (it must reach 165).
Spoon onto the rolls and serve with the carrots.

b_chocpb.t: Crockpot chocolate peanut butter oatmeal (oats mix #3)
st: Grease the crockpot lightly. Add the oats, water, milk, cocoa, vanilla and salt and stir well (the cocoa clumps).
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours overnight.
In the morning stir in the peanut butter and maple. Loosen with a splash of milk.
Top each bowl with banana slices and a few chips.

ing: 1 can (12 oz) fat free evaporated milk
12 oz cheddar block, grated or cut into small cubes
st: Put the crumbled raw turkey, onion, tomato sauce, broth, ketchup, mustard, garlic powder and salt in the crockpot.
Cook on low 4 to 5 hours, breaking up the turkey once or twice. It must reach 165.
Stir in the macaroni, turn to high and cook 30 to 45 minutes, stirring once, until tender.
Stir in the evaporated milk and cheddar until melted.
Microwave the broccoli and serve alongside. Refrigerate leftovers for Saturday lunch.

d_soymaple.t: Crockpot soy-maple chicken with rice and broccoli
ing: 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
2 cups long grain white rice, dry
st: Put the cut-up thighs in the crockpot. Stir the liquid aminos, maple, olive oil, garlic powder and 1/2 cup water together and pour over.
Cook on high about 2 to 2 1/2 hours (check at 1 1/2 hours). The pieces must reach 165 and be cooked through.
Start the rice: bring 4 cups water to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low about 18 minutes.
Stir the cornstarch mixture into the crockpot for the last 10 minutes with the lid off so the sauce thickens.
Microwave the broccoli. Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice. Refrigerate leftover chicken within 2 hours.

l_hotdogs.t: Hot dogs with carrot sticks and a mandarin
st: Heat the hot dogs in a skillet or a pot of hot water about 8 minutes. Serve on the buns with the carrots and mandarins.

l_turkey.t: Turkey and cheese sandwiches, with leftovers first
ing: 6 slices cheddar, cut from a block
st: Anyone who wants the leftover macaroni eats that. Everyone else makes a turkey and cheese sandwich. Serve with the carrots and fruit.

l_pizzabites.t: Pizza bites with carrot sticks and fruit
ing: 2 bags frozen pizza bites (about 8 per person)
st: Bake the pizza bites as directed on the bag. Serve with the carrots and fruit.

l_joes.t: Leftover sloppy joes, with turkey sandwiches if it runs short
ing: Deli turkey and bread for anyone who wants a sandwich instead
st: Reheat the sloppy joe mixture in the microwave and serve on rolls with the carrots.

d_bbq.t: Crockpot BBQ chicken sandwiches with carrot sticks
ing: 3 cups cooked chicken, shredded (leftover from Monday)
st: Put the chicken, BBQ sauce and water in the crockpot and stir.
Cook on low 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until hot all the way through (165).
Pile onto the rolls and serve with the carrots.

s_popcorn_cheese.t: White cheddar popcorn and cheese cubes
ing: 3 cheddar cubes cut from a block
st: Plate as listed.
Plate as listed.

b_ft.t: Overnight cinnamon French toast casserole (baked in the morning)
ing: 10 slices sandwich bread, cut into cubes
2 tbsp butter, melted, plus a little for greasing
1 1/4 cups plain Greek yogurt for serving
st: The night before: grease a 9x13 baking dish with a little butter and add the bread cubes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, maple, vanilla, cinnamon, salt and melted butter. Pour over the bread and press it down so it soaks. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Morning: heat the oven to 350. Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes, until set in the middle and a knife comes out clean. Rest 5 minutes.
Top each serving with a big spoonful of Greek yogurt and apple slices. Add only a tiny extra drizzle of maple if needed.

dinners: Crockpot turkey sloppy joes, carrot sticks
Crockpot BBQ chicken sandwiches, carrot sticks
method: Dinners and the grits and oatmeal breakfasts are crockpot meals. The French toast and egg bake are assembled the night before and baked in the morning. Kids are home all week, so lunches are hot dogs, pizza bites, turkey sandwiches and leftovers. Dinner is ready about 5:30 with almost no dishes.
desserts: No desserts planned for this plan.
pantry: Pantry is unknown after last week, so eyeball these before the day they are used.
Rice (2 cups), cornstarch, liquid aminos for Saturday
Fat free evaporated milk, 1 can (12 oz) for Sunday's macaroni
Peanut butter (about 3/4 cup), granola, grits, cocoa powder, maple syrup, mini chocolate chips
Hot dogs and hot dog buns: about 4 of each may be on hand
Whole chicken must be fresh, never frozen, in the crockpot
9x13 baking dish for the Monday and Tuesday breakfast casseroles

items: Apples, organic Honeycrisp or Pink Lady, 1 bag (3 lb)
Whole fresh chicken, 4 to 5 lb (Monday, never frozen)
Ground turkey, 2 lb (macaroni Sunday, sloppy joes Tuesday)
Hot dogs, 1 pack (need 10, you have about 4)
Eggs, organic, 2 dozen (egg bake 10, French toast 6)
Plain Greek yogurt, 1 tub of 32 oz
Sandwich rolls, 12 (sloppy joes and BBQ chicken)
Hot dog buns, 1 pack of 8 (need 10, you have about 4)
Rice, long grain white (2 cups needed), cornstarch, liquid aminos
Fat free evaporated milk, 1 can (12 oz)
Peanut butter (about 3/4 cup needed), granola, grits, cocoa powder, maple syrup, mini chocolate chips
Pretzels, white cheddar popcorn, Cheez-Its, ranch seasoning, mayo, yellow mustard, ketchup, Worcestershire
Tomato paste, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, olive oil, butter, vanilla
9x13 baking dish (French toast Monday, egg bake Tuesday)
